title: Convert legacy admin scripts into orchestrated runbook tasks and support automation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Background: Over the last two years we have accumulated ~30 small admin utilities (bash, Python, and ad-hoc node scripts) used by SRE and the support team. They cover user resets, cache invalidation, model pool adjustments, manual KV cache priming, and emergency service restarts. Many are untested, lack RBAC, and produce inconsistent audit traces. Goal: Replace those fragile scripts with orchestrated runbook tasks backed by the Ops Workflow Engine so support actions are auditable, role-gated, retry-safe, and callable by the SupportBot and the admin CLI adapter. This work will reduce incident MTTR, reduce blast radius from manual errors, and make runbooks-as-tasks first-class primitives in our internal tooling.
acceptance_criteria:
1) At least 12 high-frequency admin scripts converted to runbook tasks with test coverage and documented input/output schema.
2) Each task supports idempotent retries and emits structured audit logs to the Audit Events pipeline.
3) RBAC gates enforced via Admin Role tokens; web UI and CLI require explicit approval flow for destructive actions.
4) SupportBot adapter can call tasks via moderated workflow with a two-step confirmation for high-risk ops.
5) Canary rollout: tasks live in staging for 3 days, then 10% of production traffic for 48 hours before full rollout.
6) Runbook tasks surfaced in Console under a new "Managed Admin Tasks" section with cost/latency telemetry.
tasks: Inventory existing admin scripts and tag by risk/frequency (SRE + Support workshop)
Define standard task schema: inputs, outputs, validation, timeout, retry policy
Prototype SupportBot-to-task adapter and adapter unit tests
Implement RBAC hooks and KMS-based signing for high-risk ops
Migrate 12 priority scripts into task definitions with integration tests
Add structured audit event emission and map to existing audit dashboard
Console: add Managed Admin Tasks UI and test permission flows
Run canary in staging -> limited production -> full rollout with rollback playbook

rollout_plan: Phase 1: Staging test harness (all tasks) + simulated runs for 72 hours. Phase 2: Canary in production limited to on-call engineers and SupportBot test channel (10% of invocation traffic) for 48 hours. Phase 3: Full rollout with automated rollback trigger on error rate > 3% or audit failures. Post-rollout retrospective and doc updates.
